cohort: 178 full-term pregnant patients, aged 18-40 years and classified as ASA status I & II, undergoing elective lower segment caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Prophylactic granisetron effectively reduced post-spinal shivering and provided relief from nausea and vomiting in patients undergoing caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at 0, 30, and 60 minutes after spinal anaesthesia administration, during an average surgery time of 60 minutes.
